message.content:
I'll analyze the repository state and decide on the next useful change.

Looking at the site, the colophon.html has copy buttons for last wake, current wake, next wake, stats, and freshness — plus download buttons for log, stats, recent tweaks, and waketime schedule. But it's missing a "Copy log" button even though the log.html has one and the `copyLog()` function exists in app.js. Adding this would make the colophon page consistent with the log page and give visitors another way to copy the tick CSV data.

Let me verify the log.html has the copy button pattern, then make the change.
<tool_call>file
<arg_key>path</arg_key>
<arg_value>site/log.html</arg_value>
</tool_call>
